notes.title: Try my New Game with a Free Demo!
notes.content:
I'm thrilled to announce my next strategy game, Echoes of the Architects, with a free demo!

[previewyoutube=yufU_lK5zmU;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yufU_lK5zmU[/previewyoutube]

Echoes of the Architects is a fast-paced real-time strategy game that allows you to design your own modular and programmable units.
Use strategic thinking and adaptability as you deploy your army and tactics to outsmart your opponents in dynamic skirmishes.

The demo includes all core features of the game, offering 30 to 60 minutes of gameplay, where you can:

 Customize Modular Units: Design your army by choosing from a variety of modules to suit your strategy.
 Program Unit Behaviors: Set up advanced strategies with behavior scripting to outwit your opponents.
 Test Your Tactics: Engage in challenging skirmishes that require strategic planning and adaptability.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3136490/Echoes_of_the_Architects/

And if you like the demo, don't forget to add the game to your wishlist to stay updated on the full release!

Thanks for your continued support, and I can't wait to see the strategies you come up with!

Stay tactical!
GFX47

notes.title: No Plan B Steam Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=d64hiezzkZ0;full][/previewyoutube]

🗓️ Mark your calendars for April 3rd, as that's the day when No Plan B 1.0 (the full game) will officially release on Steam!

Also, don't forget to add the game to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1269020/No_Plan_B/

V1 will be packed with all the features and improvements that have been implemented during its early access phase:


 Roguelike Campaign
 Single Missions, including daily/weekly/monthly Challenges and a Mission Generator
 Survival Mode
 Unlockable Weapons, Grenades and Ballistic Shields
 Character Progression system
 Character and Weapon Customization
 Multi-Storey Buildings and their deadly stairs
 Map Editor with thousands of assets
 Mod Support + more than 80 custom missions, weapons and skins
 Steam Achievements
 And tons of other gameplay features like sniping, crouching, perks, exterior maps, new objectives, etc.


...plus a few extras for the release:

 New Squad Options: all game modes unlocked right from the start, maxed character XP and a god mode!
 New Character Voices: the good guys will get the female counterpart alongside the recent male update and the bad guys will join in with both male and female voices.


But that's not all!

Also launching on April 3rd, a "Supporter Pack" DLC will introduce fancy new character customization options to boost the tacticoolness of your squad and make your mission replays even more epic.
Check out the new possibilities on the dedicated page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2324620/No_Plan_B__Supporter_Pack

Please note that purchasing this DLC primarily demonstrates your support for the game and the customization options showcased above don't provide any gameplay advantages.
Be sure to add it to your wishlist if you are interested!

This DLC will integrate the "Supporter Edition" bundle, so players who already purchased the bundle will automatically receive the DLC on release day.

Everyone sync their timeline on April 3rd!

notes.title: The "Pimp My Gun" Contest - Call For Votes!
notes.content:
Submissions for The "Pimp My Gun" Contest are now closed. Thanks everyone for your participation!

Now it's time to vote for your 3 favorite entries using this form (you will probably need a google account).

On Friday (April 21th), I'll make a final post with the 3 winners, each will receive a key for the full game (or a 10€ Steam gift card if they already own it).

Additional rules:

 Only one vote per person!
 In case of equality, I'll decide which one wins.

notes.title: The "Pimp My Gun" Contest - Submissions open!
notes.content:
The latest major update (Beta 9) introduced weapon customization.
You can now add attachments to your guns and even change change their look.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37092585/43e8c0eb9b2d2e97713e668202f9ed0c118a4f0f.gif

Here's how to participate:
[olist]
 Launch the free demo from the store page
 Launch any mission and head to the character setup menu, then weapon customization
 Customize your favorite gun with attachements (you might need to unlock more credits by playing a few missions)
 Pick the best color pattern(s)
 Take a screenshot (pro tip: hit F5 to hide the UI)
 Post it in this discussion
[/olist]

Check out the early submissions here:
https://imgur.com/a/XRMVFvY


On Wednesday (April 19th), I'll make another post with a link to a poll for you to vote for your favorite entries. Once the votes will end (probably next week-end), the top 3 screenshots will win a key for the full game!

Additional rules:

 Only one submission by participant!
 In case of equality, I'll decide which one wins.

Good luck!

notes.title: Halloween Contest
notes.content:
How to participate

[olist]
 Install the prologue
 Play the monthly challenge mission of the SWAT faction (select SWAT / Missions / Challenges / Monthly 10/2022)
 Take a screenshot of the mission report showing the details of your score (or even better, record and share a cool replay!)
 Post it in the discussion below
[/olist]

2 keys for the full game to win!

On Tuesday (November 1st), each one of the following participants will win a key for the full game:

 the best reported score
 the best replay video


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1269020/No_Plan_B/
